latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release—empowering users to turn fabric scraps into rugged, washable braided rugs with agent-led math, scheduling, and tracking.

- Identifies suitable fabrics from user photos/inventory and calculates required rag amounts.
- Guides users through a 14-day, agent-timed cycle covering rag prep, braiding, coiling, stitching, and finishing.
- Provides pattern templates, strength testing checkpoints, and safety reminders.
- Maintains inventory, barter templates, and logs project progress and real-world durability.
- Clearly divides agent (calculation, scheduling, tracking) and human (all physical crafting) responsibilities.
